Syncing with the base branch hit a conflict, and the rebase is paused. Resolve it by hand:

Conflicted files:
{files}

1. Edit those files inside this session's worktree and remove the <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> markers
2. Then press Continue on the banner (= git add -A && git rebase --continue)
3. To drop this sync and go back to the pre-sync state, press Abort (= git rebase --abort)

airGlobalOauthTitle: Route official sessions through the proxy (OAuth replay)
airGlobalOauthRisk:
Makes sessions whose main provider is Claude official (OAuth subscription login) go through the local proxy as well — the proxy reads the subscription OAuth token from the macOS keychain and forwards it to api.anthropic.com. Its only purpose: letting the Task sub-agents of an official session route to a cheaper provider (otherwise an official session connects directly and its sub-agents must stay on the official one). Sessions with a configured provider already always go through the local proxy (127.0.0.1); this switch only affects official subscription sessions.
· Off (default, recommended): official sessions connect straight to Anthropic and their sub-agents cannot be routed independently. Zero risk.
· On: ⚠️ replays the subscription OAuth token outside the official client, which may violate Anthropic's Terms of Service and carries account risk; it also shares the keychain entry with the CLI. The keychain is read-only (never refreshed), so once the token expires you must run claude once. Only enable it knowing the risk.
